races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Aedhmar
runners_data.comment: Related to several smart sorts; cost 270,000gns as a yearling; on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to seven winners inc Head Mistress (5f 2yo inc Listed; RPR 97), Dollerina (Group-placed 7f; 97), Rule The Waves (8.4f 2yo; 94) and Crags (US 5f turf); by a quality sire and related to several smart sorts; cost 270,000gns as a yearling; on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Celestial Crown
runners_data.comment: By a first-crop sire and cost E60,000 as a yearling; the market can guide
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; closely related to 1m2f winner Mao Shang Wong (inc AW; RPR 80), half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Chicago Pope (83); dam 7f AW winner (99), from the family of 1m2f-1m4f Group 1 winner Ghaiyyath; by a first-crop sire and cost E60,000 as a yearling; the market can guide.

runners_data.name: Matriarchal
runners_data.comment: 45,000gns vendor buyback as a yearling; yard can get debut winners but likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Captain Britain (Australian 6f-1m) and Customcut (Italian 8.5f); dam French 9.5f winner, half-sister to 1m4f/12.5f Group 2 winner Loxley; a 45,000gns vendor buyback as a yearling; yard can get debut winners but likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Nevermindtherain
runners_data.comment: By a classy sire and from a quality family; top yard is in form so goes on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister to last year's 7f/1m 2yo winner Puerto Rico (inc Group 1; RPR 116); dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (102), sister to winners Misty For Me (7f-1m2f Group 1 inc Irish 1,000 Guineas) and Ballydoyle (1m 2yo Group 1); by a classy sire and from a quality family; top yard is in form so on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Velozee
runners_data.comment: E92,000 yearling is by a quality sire and from a respected yard; check the market
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Betty Loch (7f) and Scots Pine (Omani/UAE 7f-1m1f), out of 7f Listed winning half-sister to US/Canadian 1m Grade 1 winner Master Of The Seas; E92,000 yearling is by a quality sire and from a respected yard; check the market.

runners_data.name: Woodlawn Lily
runners_data.comment: By a useful sire; related to several speedy sorts; seems yard second-string
runners_data.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to winners Anthaia (Italian 5f-6f inc 2yo Listed; RPR 99), Mi Esperanza (5f; 92), Marinas Tina (US 7.5f/1m turf) and Sphere Of Fire (Italian 6f-1m); dam prolific Italian 5f-6f winner (inc 2yo); by a useful sire; related to several speedy sorts; seems yard second-string.

runners_data.name: Your Song
runners_data.comment: Cost 32,000gns as a yearling; yard has trained a 2yo winner this season; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Closely related to French Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner Tea Dance (RPR 84), half-sister to four winners inc Galinea (French 6.5f-1m 2yo inc AW; 92); dam French Group-placed 5f 2yo winner (93); by a useful sire and cost 32,000gns as a yearling; yard has trained a 2yo winner this season; respected.

races.name: Down Syndrome Centre Cork Rated Race

runners_data.name: Michael's Well
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 164 days with proven class but needs this tactical race shape to develop
runners_data.comment: No easy task under top-weight dropped to 5f on return but still progressing so respected
runners_data.spotlight: By a leading sire, especially of sprinters; both runs over 6f last year; improved from his narrow Naas debut defeat to win at Navan on soft next time; no easy task under top-weight dropped to 5f on return but still progressing so respected.

runners_data.name: Joyful Tidings
runners_data.note: Prominent runner gelded since last run with hood tried, suited by return to 5f after 6f struggles
runners_data.comment: Maiden winner over this trip not as good over 6f after; needs to return to debut effort
runners_data.spotlight: Beat the useful Arugam Bay to win a Tipperary maiden on debut last year over this trip; wasn't as good over 6f afterwards; gelded since and a hood is tried; needs to return to that debut effort.

runners_data.name: Amiata
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits this scenario, return to turf and 5f distance should aid his chances significantly
runners_data.comment: Maiden winner over this trip; easy ground should suit so is one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Navan maiden (yld) over this trip last August; wasn't beaten far on his next three starts between 5f-6f, the latter two at Dundalk; the return to 5f and easy ground should suit so is one to consider.

runners_data.name: Nakamura
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter with course form, blinkers applied and likely to control from the front throughout
runners_data.comment: Dual 6f winner incl' here; has plenty of early speed so should be comfortable at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Won back-to-back nurseries at Navan and this track last term over 6f; ran a cracker to be fourth in the Birdcatcher at Naas next time off 1lb higher than today; has plenty of early speed so should be comfortable at this trip; looks the stable selected so respected.

runners_data.name: Midnight Dusk
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who struggled on soft at Naas but improved Dundalk winner, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: AW winner reportedly wasn't at home on easy ground at this track on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Was a ready winner of a Dundalk maiden over 6f on second start but wasn't as good in a conditions event there since; reportedly wasn't at home on easy ground at this track on debut so that is a concern.

runners_data.name: Shadow Run
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner improving since gelding operation, half-length second to Oh Cecelia shows current form level
runners_data.comment: Beaten a half-length by Oh Cecelia at Naas but is 3lb better off today and should go close
runners_data.spotlight: Was regressive in three maiden runs last year but an improved effort on handicap bow on return after being gelded; was beaten a half-length by Oh Cecelia then and is 1lb wrong with her at today's weights but there still shouldn't be much between them; blinkers retained.

runners_data.name: Chicago Pope
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who beat Michael's Well last time but cheekpieces removed which may impact focus
runners_data.comment: 6f winner has early speed and could cope with this trip but looks the stable second-string
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark on final start last year when winning a Naas maiden over this trip, narrowly beating Michael's Well; the cheekpieces worn then are left off and has been gelded since; has early speed and could cope with this trip but looks the stable second-string.

runners_data.name: Oh Cecelia
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer fresh from 5f Naas win just yesterday, quick return raises stamina questions
runners_data.comment: C&D winner last year got back to form at Naas; raised 7lb for that; fifth Friday at Curragh
runners_data.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden last May but didn't progress from that over various trips; sold for 9,000GBP in January and got back to form in winning a 5f Naas handicap on stable debut; raised 7lb for that but is race-fit and has to be respected; fifth in the 1.57 Curragh Friday.

races.paceDynamic: Nakamura and Chicago Pope will share early pace-setting duties, with Joyful Tidings and Amiata tracking prominently behind them. The soft ground and 5f sprint distance should produce a steady but not excessive gallop, allowing the leaders to maintain their positions without being burned off. The pace won't be punishing enough to stop front-runners, creating a scenario where horses that can get into good early positions will have a significant tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and early pace-setters who can secure a forward position and kick for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains measured and sustainable
scenarios.body: Nakamura or Chicago Pope can control from the front and prove too strong in the closing stages. The soft ground aids stamina and the moderate gallop doesn't compromise their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters go marginally too fast early
scenarios.body: Amiata and Joyful Tidings can pounce from their tracking positions as the leaders weaken. Their class tells in a driving finish with fresher legs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Michael's Well can use his proven class to come from behind and overhaul tiring leaders. His recent 164-day break becomes less relevant in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improver Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the handicap mark proves lenient for a progressive type
scenarios.body: Shadow Run can build on his recent improved form to land a surprise blow. His half-length second to Oh Cecelia suggests he's heading in the right direction.

watchPoints.text: Michael's Well returning after 164-day absence may need the run despite his proven class advantage
Chicago Pope having cheekpieces removed after they helped secure his maiden win could affect his focus
Nakamura applying blinkers for first time which could sharpen his early pace-setting instincts
Oh Cecelia running just one day after her Naas victory creates serious stamina and recovery concerns
Shadow Run's recent improvement since gelding makes him dangerous if the pace sets up for his hold-up style

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners_data.name: Classical Symphony
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces 534 days off and faded badly on debut, making front-running pace scenario very difficult
runners_data.comment: Off since heavy debut defeat in Oct' 2024, gelded, new yard, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1 and beat just one rival home on Curragh debut in October 2024; gelded and has moved yards; can only watch after long absence.

runners_data.name: Starman Tom
runners_data.note: Unraced newcomer with unknown style but decent breeding connections to 6f winners
runners_data.comment: Starman gelding, half-brother to two winners, dam 6f 2yo winner, market best guide
runners_data.spotlight: Starman gelding; half-brother to winners Ms Willpower (6f inc 2yo/AW; RPR 94) and Kessaar Power (6f/1m inc AW; 83); dam 6f AW 2yo winner (75), half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner/Irish 1,000 Guineas runner-up Ardbrae Lady; market best guide.

runners_data.name: Cashel Blue
runners_data.note: Debutant filly from trainer having moderate season but represents Space Blues stallion
runners_data.comment: Space Blues filly, dam a 5f-6f Listed winner, likely best watched on debut unless backed
runners_data.spotlight: Space Blues filly; 3,000GBP yearling; dam 5f-6f winner (inc 2yo/AW/Listed; RPR 106), half-sister to US 5.5f winner Funny Page, out of unraced close relative of US 7f Grade 2 winner and leading sire Distorted Humor; likely best watched on debut unless backed.

runners_data.name: Sparky Sparky
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed promise on debut but needs strong pace to aim at over 5f
runners_data.comment: 11-2 and late gains for a 5.5l fourth on debut at Naas, gelded since, drop to 5f a query
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at 11-2 on debut at Naas (6f, yld-sft) last September and made late gains from the back to finish a 5.5l fourth of 12; gelded since; not sure the drop back to 5f will suit on the evidence of that debut run.

runners_data.name: Cardiff By The Sea
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Group race experience, likely pace-setter after 255 days off
runners_data.comment: Smart form last year including in the Gr' 2 Queen Mary, the one to beat if handles ground
runners_data.spotlight: Chased home Charles Darwin on debut at Naas (5f, good); ran a cracker when a 1.75l fourth behind True Love in the Queen Mary (5f, gd-fm) at Royal Ascot; reportedly slightly lame post-race when disappointing on final run of 2025 in listed heat at Naas; sets a high standard and hard to beat if handles ground.

runners_data.name: Merry Blacksmith
runners_data.note: Forward-going type who has struggled in maidens but can contribute to early pace
runners_data.comment: Modest efforts in both starts last year, qualifies for handicaps after this
runners_data.spotlight: Never figured in maidens at Listowel (7f, heavy) and Navan (6f, soft) last year; will qualify for handicaps after this.

runners_data.name: Wearing Stars
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits and has shown consistency at Dundalk, rated 73 after recent thirds
runners_data.comment: Third at Dundalk the last twice, 5f worth a go, rated 73, place shout if fit after break
runners_data.spotlight: Left form of first two runs behind when a close third at Dundalk in November (7f); beaten 1l when third again at Dundalk (6f) when last seen in December; rated 73 and worth a try over 5f; place shout if she's ready after 106 days off.

runners_data.name: Thenandnow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner officially rated 75 but disappointing when dropped to easier grade recently
runners_data.comment: Best efforts last year on good ground at 7f, needs the track to dry out on first try at 5f
runners_data.spotlight: Officially rated 75 after four runs at two, the best of which was a 1.75l second of 8 on debut at Leopardstown (7f, gd-fm); well beaten both starts on easier ground at 6f-7f so probably needs the track to dry out on first try at the minimum trip.

runners_data.name: Ace King Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style returning after 624 days absence, needs strong gallop to be effective
runners_data.comment: Promise on debut at two, not seen last year, new yard, watch unless market speaks
runners_data.spotlight: Two runs as a 2yo for the late Kevin Prendergast in 2024; promise on debut at Navan when not far behind a future Group 3 winner but last at Down Royal on second start; huge layoff to overcome and best watched on first run for new yard unless the market speaks.

runners_data.name: Fate's Gambit
runners_data.note: Prominent type who was close on Dundalk debut but struggled on turf bow 20 days ago
runners_data.comment: Second on debut at Dundalk, heavy ground may not have suited latest, place chance
runners_data.spotlight: Went close on debut at Dundalk (7f) in January but below that level twice since including on turf debut at the Curragh (6f, heavy) 20 days ago; better ground could help and worth a go at this shorter trip; place claims.

runners_data.name: White Smoke
runners_data.note: Prominent runner rated 80 who goes well on soft ground, reportedly in season last time
runners_data.comment: Rated 80, some good runs in defeat last year, 5f could suit, looks the chief danger
runners_data.spotlight: Rated 80 and ran well in defeat at times last year; narrowly denied at the Curragh (yld-sft) in September; reportedly in season when disappointing at Navan in October and AW may not have suited when last seen at Dundalk in November; 5f could suit and looks the chief danger to Cardiff By The Sea.

runners_data.name: Snap Decision
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with poor form over 7f, unlikely to benefit from shorter trip
runners_data.comment: Huge odds and no show in three 7f maidens, hard to fancy dropped in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Huge odds and has run accordingly in three 7f AW maidens; not easy to make a case for dropped back in trip.

races.paceDynamic: Cardiff By The Sea is the standout early pace angle, with her prominent style likely to dictate from the front alongside Merry Blacksmith and Wearing Stars who can also go forward. This creates a moderate tempo that won't be overly taxing, particularly on soft ground over 5f where horses don't need to sprint from the gates. The lack of genuine speed horses means the pace will be sustainable rather than frantic. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those that can travel kindly in behind, while hold-up horses like Classical Symphony and Sparky Sparky face a significant disadvantage with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cardiff By The Sea leads unchallenged and the pace stays manageable
scenarios.body: The front group maintains their advantage as hold-up horses struggle to close on the testing ground. Prominent runners can kick clear in the final furlong without serious late pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too slowly and bunch up approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: Late-running types get their chance as the race becomes a sprint finish. The soft ground aids stamina types who can sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Mid-Pack
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent horses engage early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start which suits those held up in midfield positions. Horses with tactical speed can exploit the uneven tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Cardiff By The Sea establishes a clear lead and maintains strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The favourite dictates ideal fractions and proves too strong when challenged. Her class advantage over this maiden field becomes decisive in the final 100 yards.

watchPoints.text: Cardiff By The Sea might get an uncontested lead if other prominent horses don't engage early enough
Classical Symphony and Sparky Sparky both need genuine pace to close into but may not get it
White Smoke was reportedly in season last time which could explain poor Navan effort in October
Fate's Gambit struggled on turf debut recently and may prefer all-weather surfaces
Several horses returning from long breaks including Classical Symphony (534d) and Cardiff By The Sea (255d)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cork Stakes (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: King Cuan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven 6f form on soft ground but 168 days absence is a significant concern despite his class edge
runners_data.comment: Just denied in a Group 3 last term; rated 109 and this ground suits so can be a big player
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins at 6f-7f with his best effort coming when unluckily denied by Art Power in a Group 3 (soft) at the Curragh last autumn; below form next time at Ascot but is rated 109 and this ground suits so can be a big player.

runners_data.name: Thunderbear
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up type who won Listed company over this trip but disappointing French effort raises questions about current form
runners_data.comment: Listed winner last backend and can run well if back to his best
runners_data.spotlight: Just five runs last year but won a Listed race at Naas over this trip in October before a disappointing run in France, even allowing for a less than smooth passage; can run well if back to his best.

runners_data.name: Kerdos
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who hasn't won since Group 2 success but soft ground suits and recent Dundalk run suggests he's finding form
runners_data.comment: Reasonable debut run for this yard at Dundalk but needs a return to his best to score
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't won since taking the Group 2 Temple Stakes in 2024 when with Clive Cox; posted a reasonable debut run for this yard at Dundalk and this ground will suit but needs a return to his best to score.

runners_data.name: Powerful Nation
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course form but Andrew Slattery's 5/23 record and 162-day break are major negatives
runners_data.comment: Form deteriorated from mid-season onwards and has plenty to find with Bucanero Fuerte
runners_data.spotlight: Speedy sort has won three times at 5f including twice at this track; his form deteriorated from mid-season onwards and has plenty to find with Bucanero Fuerte.

runners_data.name: Soldier's Tree
runners_data.note: Prominent type stepping up massively in class after maiden win, hat on for first time suggests connections need help
runners_data.comment: AW winner takes a major step up in class and he has loads to find
runners_data.spotlight: Easily won a 7f maiden at Dundalk on second start back in January; however, this is a major step up in class and he has loads to find.

runners_data.name: Bucanero Fuerte
runners_data.note: High-class prominent runner returning from 154 days off but his Group 1 winning form gives him clear class advantage
runners_data.comment: Group 1 winner goes well fresh and looks the one to beat with yard amongst the winners
runners_data.spotlight: Group 1 Phoenix Stakes winner returned from an aborted stud career to show hich-class form last year; won a Group 3 plus a Listed race and was third in the Group 1 Flying Five Stakes; goes well fresh and looks the one to beat with yard amongst the winners.

runners_data.name: Wannabe Royal
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who showed speed over 7f last week and gets weight relief, but major class deficit to overcome
runners_data.comment: Decent run in the Listed Gladness Stakes last week; has loads to find with some of these
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden winner over 7f ran well over that trip on return in the Listed Gladness Stakes last week; has early speed so could cope with this trip but has loads to find with some of these.

runners_data.name: Navassa Island
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with Listed placings but poor strike rate (1-20) and 147-day absence make her hard to trust
runners_data.comment: Placed in Group 3 and Listed company; will have to find improvement to take this
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1-20 but has been kept in quality company for most of her career, placed several times in Group 3 and Listed company; will have to find improvement to take this.

runners_data.name: Unique Journey
runners_data.note: Hold-up handicapper with good course record and race fitness edge from 20-day break, plus proven on this ground
runners_data.comment: Race-fitness helps and this ground is fine but has a fair bit to find with some of these
runners_data.spotlight: Smart handicapper has won three times at this trip and posted a solid return at the Curragh; his race-fitness helps and this ground is fine but has a fair bit to find with some of these.

runners_data.name: Chicago Call
runners_data.note: Hold-up 3-year-old with 7lb weight allowance but 189-day layoff and poor final start last year raise fitness doubts
runners_data.comment: Second in a Listed event last year; below form over 7f final start; a fair bit to find
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Fairyhouse maiden over this trip last July and better form when just denied in a Listed event at the same track in September; below form over 7f final start; gelded; has a fair bit to find.

runners_data.name: Magical Vision
runners_data.note: Prominent veteran who ran well last week but OR 81 rating leaves him with impossible task at this level
runners_data.comment: Solid efforts in defeat lately but is rated only 81 so has loads to find in this grade
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time winner over 5f-6f and solid handicap efforts in defeat lately but is rated only 81 so has loads to find in this grade.

races.paceDynamic: Wannabe Royal will take the field along as the only confirmed front-runner in this Listed contest, likely setting a steady rhythm on the soft ground without serious early pressure. Powerful Nation, Bucanero Fuerte, and Magical Vision may track him in second or third early, but none are committed pace pressers. The real action will come from the large hold-up contingent including King Cuan, Thunderbear, Kerdos, and Navassa Island who will look to finish strongly in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the prominent and hold-up horses who can capitalize on the likely honest pace and soft ground conditions that reward stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the soft ground takes its toll in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with the quality trio having too much class for the moderate pace-setters. King Cuan and Bucanero Fuerte emerge as the primary beneficiaries of this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bucanero Fuerte or Powerful Nation can secure the perfect tracking position behind Wannabe Royal
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more genuine with prominent runners pushing forward, creating a rhythm that suits horses with natural speed who don't need to come from too far back. Bucanero Fuerte's class tells from an ideal stalking position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Wannabe Royal goes too slowly and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a messy sprint finish where anything can happen, potentially suiting the handier types who can quicken fastest. Chicago Call's 3-year-old allowance becomes crucial in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Wannabe Royal gets soft fractions and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The pace-setter capitalizes on going unopposed early and finds enough acceleration to hold off the late challengers on ground that saps their finishing speed. His recent run over 7f suggests the stamina is there.

watchPoints.text: Bucanero Fuerte market moves given his 154-day absence could signal readiness to resume Group-class form first time back
Wannabe Royal's early fractions as lone leader will dictate whether hold-up horses get their preferred strong pace setup
King Cuan's jumping from the stalls after 168-day break will reveal whether rust affects his chances despite obvious class
Any significant market drift on Thunderbear whose French disappointment makes his current wellbeing questionable
Late betting moves on Chicago Call whose 7lb allowance could prove decisive if the pace sets up for his hold-up style

races.name: Mallow Garden Festival 22nd, 23rd & 24th May Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Flagstone Lady
runners_data.comment: US Navy Flag filly, dam French Listed placed winner, watch unless the market speaks
runners_data.spotlight: US Navy Flag filly; E1,000 foal bought back for E21,000 as a yearling; half-sister to winners Wonder Kid (1m2f/1m4f, RPR 101), Bavardages (7f-1m2f inc 2yo/AW; 83) and Doves Of Peace (6f AW; 61); dam French Listed-placed 7f-1m1f winner (inc 2yo; 94); likely best watched unless the market speaks.

runners_data.name: Flower Forest
runners_data.comment: Siyouni filly, dam a sister to Gleneagles, Marvellous & Happily, Moore prefers stablemate
runners_data.spotlight: Siyouni filly; half-sister to Canadian 7f turf winner War Strategy; dam 7f 2yo Group 3 winner (RPR 106), sister to Group 1 winners Gleneagles (7f/1m), Marvellous (1m), Happily (7f/1m) and Joan Of Arc (10.5f), out of 6f 2yo Group 2 winner; impeccably bred but Signora preferred by Ryan Moore.

runners_data.name: Mardi Gras Queen
runners_data.comment: Charlatan filly, half-sister to yard's US Grade 1 winner Aspen Grove, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Charlatan filly; half-sister to yard's winner Aspen Grove (1m-1m3f inc 2yo/US Grade 1; RPR 114) and Edwardian (5f 2yo; 87); dam US Graded stakes-placed 1m turf 2yo winner, half-sister to winners Skitter Scatter (7f 2yo Group 1); entered in the 1000 Guineas and worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Wild Bessie
runners_data.comment: Off since midfield finish on Dundalk debut in Sept', needs to improve plenty on that
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 and never better than midfield on debut in a 7f Dundalk maiden in September; not seen since and needs to improve plenty to feature here.

runners_data.name: Magna Kotcha
runners_data.comment: 100-1 on debut at Naas (1m) and weakened late into sixth, much more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at 100-1 on debut at Naas (1m, soft) 13 days ago and weakened late on into an 8.25l sixth of 10; Keane takes over now and drop to 7f a plus but much more needed.

runners_data.name: Divine Legend
runners_data.comment: 9-1 and beaten 14.5l on debut in Oct', needs to step forward massively from that
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at 9-1 on debut at Leopardstown (7f, yielding) in October and was beaten 14.5l into fifth of 13; this Irish 1000 Guineas entrant will need to step forward massively from that.

runners_data.name: Signora
runners_data.comment: Smart form at two, keen when reeled in late on return at the Curragh, the one to beat
runners_data.spotlight: Smart form on debut behind Lady Iman in Naas Group 3 (6f, good); didn't back that up when midfield in the Albany at Royal Ascot; raced keenly when reeled in late on seasonal reappearance in a 7f Curragh maiden (heavy); rated 92, preferred by Moore and the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Expert Dancer
runners_data.comment: Two promising 6f maiden runs last term, 7f should suit, yard in fine form, place shout
runners_data.spotlight: Eyecatcher when making late gains on debut at Naas over 6f in October; another solid run when a 3.5l third on heavy at the Curragh (6f) nine days later; yard in form and the step up to 7f looks sure to suit; place claims.

runners_data.name: Zermatt Star
runners_data.comment: Keen in both starts at two at around 1m, needs to settle better dropped in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Raced keenly on both starts last year when a 4.75l sixth at Punchestown (1m, gd-yld) and a 6.25l fifth at Gowran (8.5f, heavy) when sent off the 9-4 favourite; drops in trip now and needs to settle better.

runners_data.name: Girl Bear
runners_data.comment: Good effort on debut at Galway, below that level on seasonal return, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Went close on debut at Galway (7f, soft) in September; 5-1 but soundly beaten on seasonal reappearance at the Curragh (7f, heavy); should strip fitter now but needs to improve markedly on that latest effort.

runners_data.name: Star Of Beauty
runners_data.comment: Good third at Naas in August, had pipe opener at Dundalk, rated 75, place shout; visored
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort at two a 0.5l third of 13 in a 6f maiden at Naas on her second start in August; first run since a 5.75l sixth of 14 in a 1m maiden at Dundalk 29 days ago; visor goes on and drops in trip; rated 75 and has a place chance.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Noblesse Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares)

runners_data.name: Magical Zoe
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 588 days off but showed excellent form transitioning from hurdles to flat in 2024
runners_data.comment: Won the 2024 Ebor on last start; difficult to get behind her after a long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Grade 3-winning hurdler turned into a useful Flat performer in 2024; finished third in a Fairyhouse Grade 3 over 1m6f before winning the Ebor over the same trip; however, hasn't been seen since and difficult to get behind her after a long absence; the market might reveal her readiness.

runners_data.name: Moody
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity after 267-day break with new trainer Paddy Twomey having minimal recent winners
runners_data.comment: Maiden winner in France; a fair bit to find on form and seems the yard's second-string
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Clairefontaine maiden over 1m1f on second start for Andre Fabre last year; sold for E125,000 to current trainer since; has a fair bit to find on form and seems the yard's second-string; tongue-tie plus cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Wemightakedlongway
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who should get uncontested lead but needs to prove stamina holds at this trip
runners_data.comment: Listed winner; ground-versatile and rated 110 so is the one to beat if ready on return
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Navan 1m2f Listed race on soft last year; loads of good runs in defeat after in Group 1s up to 1m4f including in Oaks/Irish Oaks and a French Group 1; is ground-versatile and rated 110 so is the one to beat if ready enough on return.

runners_data.name: Elana Osario
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying 5lb penalty who won the Group 3 over this course and distance last August
runners_data.comment: A Group 3 C&D winner; big player on seasonal debut despite carrying a 5lb penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Tremendously progressive last year when her three wins included the Group 3 Give Thanks Stakes over C&D last August; raced keenly when not at her best over 1m6f next time; should be a big player on seasonal debut despite carrying a 5lb penalty.

runners_data.name: Snapretend
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid Listed form over this trip and handles soft ground well
runners_data.comment: Decent sort has a bit to find with some of these rivals on return but could run well
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 1m1f Punchestown maiden and a 1m4f Bellewstown conditions race last year; a creditable effort when third in a heavy-ground Curragh Listed race (also 1m4f) final start; has a bit to find with some of these rivals on return but could run well.

runners_data.name: Carmel's Phoenix
runners_data.note: Inexperienced hold-up type making big step up in class after only maiden company
runners_data.comment: Beaten 1.75l at Bellewstown over this trip on last start; however, this looks ambitious
runners_data.spotlight: The best of two maiden runs last year when beaten 1.75l at Bellewstown over this trip; however, this looks an ambitious starting point for this term.

runners_data.name: Speckled Meadow
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse rated far too low at 74 to compete at this level
runners_data.comment: Four handicap wins up to 1m2.5f but is rated only 74 so has a mountain to climb
runners_data.spotlight: Four handicap wins up to 1m2.5f but seems to stay this trip too; however, is rated only 74 so has a mountain to climb.

runners_data.name: It's A Heartbeat
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after finishing lame last time but has won over this course and distance
runners_data.comment: Finished lame when poor in a Naas Listed on final start; can be a player on return though
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden and handicap at the Curragh over this trip last year; started favourite but finished lame when poor in a Naas Listed contest final start; however, can be a player on return if resuming her progression.

races.paceDynamic: Wemightakedlongway stands out as the sole natural front-runner in this field of eight, likely to set a comfortable pace from Elana Osario and It's A Heartbeat tracking prominently. The soft ground and 1m4f trip on Cork's galloping track will create a searching test of stamina in the final three furlongs. With most runners preferring to be held up including dangerous closers Magical Zoe and Snapretend, the early pace should be modest before quickening from halfway. This race shape clearly favours patient hold-up horses who can finish strongly up the testing Cork hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate as expected with Wemightakedlongway controlling from the front
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Magical Zoe and Snapretend will prove ideal as they sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. The soft ground and stamina test plays perfectly into the hands of horses held up for late strikes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Elana Osario or It's A Heartbeat can track the pace and kick clear from 2f out
scenarios.body: Racing handy to the moderate gallop allows one of the prominent runners to get first run on the field. Their tactical position gives them the jump on the hold-up horses who need more room to manoeuvre.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Wemightakedlongway gets away with very soft sectionals and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to save energy for a decisive move. Ryan Moore times his effort perfectly as the closers leave their runs too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite Magical Zoe fails to handle the return to turf after her hurdling campaign
scenarios.body: The market leaders underperform leaving the door open for an improving type. Moody's French form or Carmel's Phoenix's improvement from a break could surprise at big odds.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Wemightakedlongway gets very soft early fractions as Ryan Moore could steal this from the front
Monitor Magical Zoe's jumping from the stalls given her long absence and recent hurdling background
Check if It's A Heartbeat shows any signs of the lameness issue that ended her last campaign
Observe Moody's early positioning as Colin Keane may need to be more positive than usual given her lack of recent runs
Watch for Snapretend to be produced with a sweeping run from the back as she needs the strong pace to aim at

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Handicap

runners_data.name: Perisher
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 193-day break, gelded and likely to appreciate the mile trip on seasonal return
runners_data.comment: Promise in maidens last year, gelded, handicap debutant worth market check
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in maidens at 7f-8.5f last season on varying ground; in good hands, has been gelded ahead of seasonal return and the market should reveal expectations on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Chapel Lane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid maiden form, trainer struggling for winners but going preference suits
runners_data.comment: Solid maiden form, opening mark could be workable, go well if fit and handles ground
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well in two of three maiden starts last year at 6f-1m on good and good to yielding ground; was 3l behind the 94-rated Killashee Warrior on final run of 2025 at Thurles (1m, gd-yld) in first-time visor (discarded); opening mark of 75 could be workable; could go well.

runners_data.name: Felix Somary
runners_data.note: Prominent style, needed recent return and softer ground could help after poor efforts on firmer surfaces
runners_data.comment: Sligo maiden winner, no joy since, dropped 2lb after modest comeback run, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Won on debut at Sligo (6f, gd-yld) but no joy in three starts since, the last twice in handicaps; another modest effort on seasonal return; may have needed that but needs more off 2lb lower.

runners_data.name: Adel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut from out of the weights, gelded since last season
runners_data.comment: Not a bad run when 4lb wrong in Madrid, this is less demanding, interesting runner
runners_data.spotlight: Modest efforts in 1m maidens last year; gelded and returned with a midfield finish on handicap bow at Naas in the Madrid (7f, soft) from 4lb out of the handicap; shaped as though that was needed and this is less demanding; interesting.

runners_data.name: Empty Wallet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with maiden win under belt, 168-day break but proven soft ground form
runners_data.comment: Down 3lb after midfield run on h'cap bow in Oct', yard had first time out winner on Wed'
runners_data.spotlight: Bellewstown maiden winner (1m, good); not disgraced in Listed heat at Tipperary (7.5f, good); stayed on after being outpaced on handicap debut at Leopardstown (1m, yld-sft) in October; 3lb lower now and yard had first time out winner on Wednesday.

runners_data.name: Hambelton
runners_data.note: Unclear style but history suggests fades in finish, gelded and making handicap debut off low mark
runners_data.comment: Similar form in three maidens last year, open to improvement on h'cap debut, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Ran to a similar level in a trio of maidens last year at 7f-1m on easy ground and on the AW; has been gelded and open to improvement on handicap debut off what looks a fair mark; market can guide.

runners_data.name: Invincible Will
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping back to winning distance, excellent soft ground record with four from eight starts
runners_data.comment: Won off 6lb lower last term, off since well beaten in Oct', gelded, yard amongst winners
runners_data.spotlight: Won off 6lb lower at the Curragh (7f, yld-sft) last September on his seventh start (beat Sunrise Angel by a neck); never involved off 6lb higher upped to a mile at Leopardstown the following month; off since and has been gelded; yard amongst winners recently.

runners_data.name: Nod Of Approval
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who stayed on well at Leopardstown, 1lb drop in weights for promising effort
runners_data.comment: Promise in maidens, okay run on h'cap debut, down 1lb, lacks a run, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in maidens and again on handicap debut at Leopardstown (1m, yld-sft) when last seen in October; dropped 1lb for that staying on 6.25l fifth of 12 and worth a market check on return.

runners_data.name: Sunrise Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 3lb better terms with Invincible Will from previous meeting
runners_data.comment: 3lb swing for neck defeat to Invincible Will last year, yard in form, dangerous to dismiss
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a neck by Invincible Will on handicap debut at the Curragh (7f, yld-sft) in September and 3lb better off with that rival here; raised 4lb and finished a 1l fourth of 13 on final run of 2025 at Dundalk (7f); yard in flying form and dangerous to discount.

runners_data.name: Love Orchid
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 232-day break, question marks over soft ground suitability
runners_data.comment: Best maiden effort over 6f at Dundalk, handicap debutante might prefer better ground
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort in maidens came on her third start at Dundalk (6f) in August; non-runner on account of yielding to soft ground at Naas in September so may need the track to dry out to make an impact on her handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Perisher looks the clear pace angle with his prominent style, likely joined by Felix Somary, Adel, and Sunrise Angel in the early stages. This creates a reasonable gallop but nothing too fierce given the small field and mix of hold-up horses. The soft ground will make it more taxing in the final furlong, with Empty Wallet, Chapel Lane, Invincible Will, Nod Of Approval, and Love Orchid all needing to be produced with well-timed runs. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish with one sustained effort on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and the soft ground takes its toll in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will tire late and those coming from behind with one run will have the decisive advantage. Empty Wallet and Nod Of Approval are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Perisher and the early leaders go too slow through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where those with natural speed can quicken best regardless of position. Felix Somary and Sunrise Angel could capitalise on their pace despite prominent positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Felix Somary and Adel pressure Perisher into a genuine gallop from the start
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up the race for the closers but may compromise some hold-up horses who get too far back. Chapel Lane and Invincible Will benefit most from this honest tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Perisher gets an uncontested lead and the field allows him easy fractions
scenarios.body: He can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back on the soft ground despite lacking pure pace. Sunrise Angel tracking prominently could also benefit from the tactical advantage.

watchPoints.text: Love Orchid was a non-runner on yielding to soft ground previously so genuine stamina concerns on this surface
Hambelton has shown a pattern of fading in the finish across three starts and may repeat under pressure
Felix Somary needed his seasonal return badly and could strip fitter with the run under his belt
Perisher faces a significant test returning from 193 days off in what will be a tactical examination
The market moves on Perisher will be crucial given the stable's 3/30 recent record but O'Brien's class
